title: A supervised machine learning approach identifies gene-regulating factor-mediated competing endogenous RNA networks in hormone-dependent cancers.
authors: Jayarathna, Dulari K; Renteria, Miguel E; Batra, Jyotsna; Gandhi, Neha S
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习整合多组学数据推断ceRNA网络，虽涉及转录因子数据但核心是RNA调控网络，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Competing endogenous RNAs (ceRNAs) have become an emerging topic in cancer research due to their role in gene regulatory networks. To date, traditional ceRNA bioinformatic studies have investigated microRNAs as the only factor regulating gene expression. Growing evidence suggests that genomic (e.g., copy number alteration [CNA]), transcriptomic (e.g., transcription factors [TFs]), and epigenomic (e.g., DNA methylation [DM]) factors can influence ceRNA regulatory networks. Herein, we used the Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression, a machine learning approach, to integrate DM, CNA, and TFs data with RNA expression to infer ceRNA networks in cancer risk. The gene-regulating factors-mediated ceRNA networks were identified in four hormone-dependent (HD) cancer types: prostate, breast, colorectal, and endometrial. The shared ceRNAs across HD cancer types were further investigated using survival analysis, functional enrichment analysis, and protein-protein interaction network analysis. We found two (BUB1 and EXO1) and one (RRM2) survival-significant ceRNA(s) shared across breast-colorectal-endometrial and prostate-colorectal-endometrial combinations, respectively. Both BUB1 and BUB1B genes were identified as shared ceRNAs across more than two HD cancers of interest. These genes play a critical role in cell division, spindle-assembly checkpoint signalling, and correct chromosome alignment. Furthermore, shared ceRNAs across multiple HD cancers have been involved in essential cancer pathways such as cell cycle, p53 signalling, and chromosome segregation. Identifying ceRNAs' roles across multiple related cancers will improve our understanding of their shared disease biology. Moreover, it contributes to the knowledge of RNA-mediated cancer pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 竞争性内源RNA（ceRNAs）已成为癌症研究中的一个新兴课题，因其在基因调控网络中的作用而受到关注。迄今为止，传统的ceRNA生物信息学研究仅将microRNAs视为调控基因表达的唯一因素。越来越多的证据表明，基因组（如拷贝数变异 [CNA]）、转录组（如转录因子 [TFs]）和表观基因组（如DNA甲基化 [DM]）因素可影响ceRNA调控网络。在此，我们采用最小绝对收缩和选择算子回归（一种机器学习方法），将DM、CNA和TFs数据与RNA表达整合，以推断癌症风险中的ceRNA网络。在四种激素依赖性（HD）癌症类型中识别了由基因调控因子介导的ceRNA网络：前列腺癌、乳腺癌、结直肠癌和子宫内膜癌。进一步通过生存分析、功能富集分析和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析，研究了HD癌症类型间共享的ceRNAs。我们发现，在乳腺癌-结直肠癌-子宫内膜癌组合中共享了两个生存显著的ceRNAs（BUB1和EXO1），而在前列腺癌-结直肠癌-子宫内膜癌组合中共享了一个（RRM2）。BUB1和BUB1B基因均被识别为超过两种相关HD癌症间共享的ceRNAs。这些基因在细胞分裂、纺锤体组装检查点信号传导和正确染色体排列中发挥关键作用。此外，多种HD癌症间共享的ceRNAs涉及关键癌症通路，如细胞周期、p53信号传导和染色体分离。识别ceRNAs在多种相关癌症中的作用将增进我们对它们共享疾病生物学的理解，并有助于了解RNA介导的癌症发病机制。
